name: ch.antevo/strategy-radar
title: Strategy Radar
description: A daily board of risks and opportunities for companies, matched to your strategy in your assistant.

tools.name: get_strategy_radar_setup
tools.description: Set up Strategy Radar for a company: everything a company's own assistant needs to match Antevo's daily business board of risks and opportunities to that company's strategy. Returns the five setup questions (about three minutes, no figures) and the fuller profile, the exposure-tag vocabulary, the matching method, the text of a weekday morning task, the page layout for drawing the radar, and the two disclosure lines. Takes no input: the company's answers stay with its assistant and never reach Antevo.

tools.name: get_business_board
tools.description: What changed for a company's strategy today: Antevo's business board for the day, the board behind Strategy Radar. Risks and opportunities for companies from trade, regulation, supply, shipping, energy, demand, currencies, funding, labour, technology, cyber, geopolitics and climate. Each entry carries its theme, exposure tags, impact, likelihood and trend in words, why it matters with a date, what to watch, the event that would make a response right, and two or three possible responses with their reasons. Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past board within the last 400 days. Takes no company details; matching to a company happens in the company's own assistant.
